name: Powder recovery bag filter
reviewFindings: Draft typical inlet 140-145 degC, outlet 80-90 degC and approximate product discharge 60-100 degC coexist with temperatures TBD. No operating or safety setpoint is selected.

Draft routes dryer output through F-601 to T-602; the model also has a direct DR-601 powder chute to T-602. Draft exhaust arrow calls for off-gas treatment, while its scrubber note mentions atmospheric discharge. Model retains an independent discharge boundary; neither a common treatment header nor permitted release is established.

Atomizer technology, evaporation duty, heating medium, gas flow/pressure budget, moisture target, capacities and materials remain unqualified. The model is aqueous; the draft scrubber solvent-vapor wording requires reconciliation and does not add a solvent-recovery system.

Air is a draft/model concept. Gas selection, GO thermal stability, dust explosibility, grounding, dryer/filter protection, pressure limits and interlocks remain open. Conditional oxygen monitoring for inert drying is not an installed protective system.

Sheet is Draft - Not for Use with revision XXX. Wash compatibility, powder isolation, filter-media servicing, scrubber-liquor chemistry, drain receivers and gas-admission procedures require approval. No common process/thermal drain or cleaning sequence is authorized.
